<img src="data:image/gif;base64," class="MCToggler_Image_Icon" data-mc-alt2="Open" width="16" height="11" alt="Closed" />124 - Unable to import file (File Import service)</a>

<div class="drop-down" style="display: none;" mc-target-name="124">

This message indicates that the File Import service was unable to import the named file.

- Message Text: Unable to import file (File Import service)
- Date 1 Usage: File Type
- Data 5 Usage: File Name
- Message Class: 3 (Information)
- Message Priority: 5 (Logged)

</div>

#### <a href="javascript:void(0);" class="MCToggler MCTogglerHead MCTogglerHotSpot MCToggler_Open toggler togglerexception MCTogglerHotSpot_ MCTogglerHotSpot_exception MCHotSpotImage" data-mc-targets="126">

<img src="data:image/gif;base64," class="MCToggler_Image_Icon" data-mc-alt2="Open" width="16" height="11" alt="Closed" />126 - Finalized custody ticket was saved but a reversal record was not created</a>

<div class="drop-down" style="display: none;" mc-target-name="126">

When the FLOWCAL option "Create Reversal Tickets on Edit" is enabled, a ticket that has a class of Custody is edited, and the new revision that is created has a status of Final, FLOWCAL will compare the new revision to the record's prior revision that has a status of Final, Confirmed, or Closed. If no data point was changed that is in fc_reversal_field or fc_reversal_component_field for the corresponding ticket type and system, then a reversal record is not created in the DUP table and this message will be generated.

- Message Text: Finalized custody ticket was saved but a reversal record was not created
- Data 1 Usage: Effective Date
- Data 2 Usage: Ticket Index
- Message Class: 3 (Information)
- Message Priority: 5 (Logged)

</div>

<a href="javascript:void(0);" class="MCToggler MCTogglerHead MCTogglerHotSpot MCToggler_Open toggler togglerexception MCTogglerHotSpot_ MCTogglerHotSpot_exception MCHotSpotImage" data-mc-targets="141">
